decisions.reason: The no-add-ons decision applies to the Zapier Professional subscription and does not change the independently selected MeetAlfred Pro plan.
The email campaigns use MeetAlfred, and the Zapier add-on selection does not necessarily change their channel, automation mode, or platform.
The Zapier subscription add-on decision does not change the separate Apollo account setup requirement.
The source selects a Zapier subscription configuration but does not alter the required HubSpot-to-MeetAlfred list synchronization behavior.
Choosing Zapier Professional without add-ons does not change the obligation to preserve existing MeetAlfred campaigns.
The Zapier plan configuration does not change the restriction against using existing MeetAlfred leads for testing.
The source does not resume or otherwise change the deferred LinkedIn campaign automation requirement.
The Zapier add-on choice does not alter the separate Sales Navigator lead-list setup obligation.
The source does not change Apollo as the enrichment provider, its automatic mode, HubSpot synchronization, or expected latency.
The Zapier subscription configuration does not necessarily modify the defined Apollo-to-HubSpot contact synchronization behavior.
The no-add-ons decision for Zapier does not change the Sales Navigator-to-Apollo export behavior.
The source does not alter silent-lead selection, follow-up list handling, MeetAlfred transfer behavior, or the no-manual-cleanup rule.
